size.value: 2 x 2 pulgadas (5 x 5 cm), per ICAO Document 9303 ("La fotografía digital debe tener un tamaño de 2 x 2 pulgadas (5 x 5 cm) según el documento 9303 de la Organización de Aviación Civil Internacional") — matches DB's 2×2 inch (51×51mm)

glasses_policy.value: No sunglasses ("gafas de sol"); no colored contact lenses ("no utilizar lentes de contacto de color")

accessories.value: No facial adornments; no earrings ("aretes"), no chains/necklaces ("cadenas") — "Las fotos no deben incluir adornos faciales ni prendas de vestir como gafas de sol, aretes, cadenas, sombreros"

headwear_policy.value: No hats ("sombreros") per the same prohibited-items list

file_spec.value: For online/digital submission, documents including the photo must be scanned in JPG format ("Los documentos deben ser escaneados en formato JPG")

glasses.en: Sunglasses are not allowed, and colored contact lenses must not be worn.
glasses.ko: 선글라스 착용 불가, 컬러 콘택트렌즈 착용 금지.
glasses.ja: サングラスは不可。カラーコンタクトレンズの着用も不可。

accessories.en: No facial adornments; earrings and necklaces/chains are not allowed in the photo.
accessories.ko: 얼굴 장신구 금지. 귀걸이, 목걸이·체인 등 착용 금지.
accessories.ja: 顔まわりの装飾品は不可。イヤリング・ネックレス(チェーン類)の着用も不可。

direct_fetch_note.note: Direct WebFetch to pasaportes.gob.do returned HTTP 473 (bot-protection status) on repeated attempts. Content above was confirmed via a grounded web-search fetch that quoted verbatim Spanish text specifically attributed to the pasaportes.gob.do adult first-time passport application page (Dirección General de Pasaportes, the Dominican Republic's official passport authority) — not from third-party passport-photo vendors.
